'''MD-4''' was an [[MD-4 medical droid]] assigned to the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate/Legends|EF76 Nebulon-B escort frigate]]. Its service carried over once the ship's crew [[Mutiny on the Far Orbit|mutined]] and took over control of the vessel. MD-4 oversaw the ship's surgery unit with assistance from [[MD-2]].<ref name="FOP" />
